movement_profile.formation_and_space: Varies across the entire theatrical stage or chosen scenic space
movement_profile.partnering: Dramatic physical interaction between performers, alternating between contact and confrontation

signature_moves.description: Movement material derived from personal, emotional explorations during creative rehearsals.
signature_moves.name: Emotional improvisation (Bewegungen)

signature_moves.description: Obsessive recurrence of dramatic physical phrases across the performance.
signature_moves.name: Scenic repetition

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Shifts between sustained emotional stillness and repetitive, obsessive pacing
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Superficial technical virtuosity devoid of genuine human, social, or emotional content.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Management of linear choreographic time and silences
music_profile.sound_description: Soundscapes in Tanztheater balance audible accompaniment with deliberate silence. The auditory pacing is dictated by the dramatic tension on the theatrical stage rather than strict musical dance meters.
music_profile.vocal_style: Spoken text and theatrical vocalisations integrated with movement

teaching.formation: Varies by choreographic production across theatrical and dramatic staging.
teaching.level_notes: Performers must operate simultaneously as dramatic actors and trained dancers, building choreographic material from emotional improvisations.
teaching.rhythm: Constructed through choreographic timing, silences, and dramatic musicality rather than fixed metrical steps.
